title: 第十七章 截杀第十八章 下杀手
lines: 爆炸的余波还在洛阳城的上空回荡。
城东仓库的大火烧了整整一天，黑烟遮蔽了半边天。洛天王朝的修士们从四面八方赶来，救火、搜捕、盘查。有人在废墟中找到了几块黑色的令牌碎片，碎得厉害，上面的纹路已经看不清了。有人在现场辨认出了天阙宗少宗主的灵力残留——温热而松散的木属性气息，像春天的风，但飘忽不定。
消息像长了翅膀一样传遍了洛阳城。
天阙宗少宗主，炸了城东的仓库。
没有人知道仓库里装的是什么。但所有人都知道——这件事，不会善了。
翌日清晨，皇宫传出消息：祭天大典改期。
官方说法是“天象有变，需另择吉日”。但所有人都知道，真正的原因是城东那场爆炸。祭天台离城东不远，万一还有余党，万一还有第二波袭击，万一祭天大典上出了什么事——
没有人敢赌。
更重要的是涉及了天阙宗的少宗主，洛天王朝谁也不敢乱来，只能静待其变。
苏府，书房
苏远山和长孙岳坐在一起，桌上摊着一张刚送来的密函。
“出事了。”苏远山的声音很低，“天阙宗那边有动静。”
长孙岳没有说话。
“祖破军把那个化神初期的护卫调回去了。”苏远山将密函推过来，“说是‘另有任用’。”
长孙岳扫了一眼密函上的字。另有任用。四个字，写得很官方。
但长孙岳知道这不是“另有任用”。城东的仓库被炸，不管那批东西是谁的，背后的人一定会去找祖破军对质。这个时候，祖破军把护卫调回去——是为了加强天阙宗的防御，还是在怀疑什么？
“还有。”苏远山的手指敲了敲桌面，“天阙五雄要来了。”
长孙岳的眉头微微一动。
“那五个？”
“那五个！”苏远山说，“祖破军把他们全部调来了洛阳城。接替那个化神护卫的任务，明着是负责他儿子的安全，实际上应该是要给洛天王朝施压。”
“全部？”
“老五和老四先出发，明天就到。老大、老二、老三还有别的事，晚两天。”
长孙岳沉默了片刻。
天阙五雄。当年灭门案的具体执行者。他们的手上，沾着长孙家的血。
终于出宗门了。
“情报准确吗？”
“苏家在天阙宗的暗桩传来的。”苏远山的声音压得很低，“老五和老四走官道，明天午时前后经过青石岭。”
长孙岳看着地图上那个标记，没有说话。
“你打算怎么办？”苏远山问。
长孙岳没有回答。他站起身，将地图折好，收入怀中。
content_en:
The aftermath of the explosion is still echoing over Luoyang City.
The fire in the warehouse in the east of the city burned for a whole day, and black smoke obscured half of the sky. Monks from the Luotian Dynasty came from all directions to put out fires, search and investigate. Someone found several black token fragments in the ruins. They were so broken that the lines on them could no longer be seen clearly. Someone at the scene recognized the remnants of the spiritual power of the young master of the Tianque Sect - a warm and loose wood-attribute breath, like the spring wind, but erratic.
The news spread throughout Luoyang City like it had wings.
The young master of Tianque Sect blew up the warehouse in the east of the city.
No one knew what was in the warehouse. But everyone knows that this matter will not be good.
In the early morning of the next day, news came from the palace: the heaven-sacrifice ceremony was rescheduled.
The official statement is that "the celestial phenomena have changed and another auspicious day needs to be chosen." But everyone knew that the real cause was the explosion in the east of the city. The Heaven Sacrifice Platform is not far from the east side of the city. If there are any remaining party members, if there is a second wave of attacks, if something happens during the Heaven Sacrifice Ceremony——
No one dares to bet.
What's more important is that the young master of the Tianque Sect is involved. No one in the Luotian Dynasty dares to mess around and can only wait for the change.
——
Su Mansion, study room
Su Yuanshan and Changsun Yue were sitting together, with a secret letter that had just been sent spread out on the table.
"Something happened." Su Yuanshan's voice was very low, "There is something going on over at Tianque Sect."
Changsun Yue said nothing.
"Zu Pojun transferred back the guard who was in the early stage of becoming a god." Su Yuanshan pushed the secret letter over and said, "It was said that he had another appointment."
Changsun Yue glanced at the words on the secret letter. There are other appointments. Four words, written very officially.
But Changsun Yue knew that this was not "another appointment." The warehouse in the east of the city was bombed. No matter who owns those things, the person behind them will definitely go to Zu Pojun to confront them. At this time, Zu Pojun transferred the guards back - was it to strengthen Tianque Sect's defense, or was he suspecting something?
"Also." Su Yuanshan tapped his fingers on the table, "The Five Heroes of Tianque are coming."
Changsun Yue's brows moved slightly.
"Those five?"
"Those five!" Su Yuanshan said, "Zu Pojun transferred them all to Luoyang City. Taking over the task of the god-incarnation guard is obviously responsible for the safety of his son, but in fact it should be to put pressure on the Luotian Dynasty."
"All?"
"The fifth and fourth sons will leave first and arrive tomorrow. The eldest, second and third sons have other things to do and will be two days late."
Changsun Yue was silent for a moment.
Tianque Wuxiong. The specific executor of the family extermination case that year. Their hands were stained with the blood of the Changsun family.
Finally left the sect.
"Is the information accurate?"
"It came from the Su family's hidden stake in Tianque Sect." Su Yuanshan's voice was very low, "The fifth and fourth children are taking the official road and passing by Qingshi Ridge around noon tomorrow."
Changsun Yue looked at the mark on the map and said nothing.
"What are you going to do?" Su Yuanshan asked.
Changsun Yue did not answer. He stood up, folded the map and put it in his arms.
